sentences.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
sentences.zh: 只有能引发新问题的答案才是有用的。

sentences.en: Rocks and minerals are useful for us in many ways.
sentences.zh: 岩石和矿物以多种方式对我们有用。

sentences.en: The extra room proved very useful when we had visitors.
sentences.zh: 多出来那间房在我们有客人的时候非常有用。
